newsitem.title: USA: Rich International Airways files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Rich International Airways files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Rich International Airways Inc said on Monday it filed for Chapter 11 reorganization in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Florida.
The Miami-based charter airline said that the filing would permit it to conserve cash and direct resources toward resumption of flight operations at the earliest possible date.
The Federal Aviation Administration grounded Rich on September 2 primarily because of discrepencies found in crew training records.
The airline said it believed it was nearing the end of its revalidation program, a cooperative undertaking between the company and the FAA.
